description: NIS2 incident-notification deadlines for a country: the 24h/72h/1-month stages with their national legal basis, the competent authority/CSIRT and portal, the sector routing (a sector CSIRT or authority that receives instead of, or with, the national one; pass `sector` for the recipient of one organisation), and the national severity vocabulary (e.g. Italy's ACN IS-1..IS-4 typologies, with their entity-class applicability).

sector.description: NIS2 sector id of the organisation. When given, `recipients` names who receives its notification: some countries route a whole sector to another body, and a rule over part of a sector comes back as a condition to check.

name: incident_deadline_formats
title: Incident notification deadlines per country
